message:
test(rel-0164): old-APK lane r7c -- 4 is the tap's own down->up at one position inside the window; the Windows tab judged visible and enabled

verify-0164 on 69ff7e3 (seq16090): 4 passed on any new [input-trace] line within 3 s of the tap -- no tie to the tap.
On 665a47d:
- judge_input reads ONLY the host's lines after the offset taken just before the tap. The FIRST button down (kind 2)
  must be followed by a button up (kind 3, higher seq) at the same position (within 2 px), both inside the pinned
  window's picture (the host's [keyframe] size). Kinds from the source on both ends: host_control_session.cpp:1296
  (the seam's trace of kinds 1-4) and b554e76 MainActivity.kt:72-75 (1 move, 2 down, 3 up, 4 wheel).
- LIMIT, written in the code: 0.2.32's DIRECT tap maps the view point into the picture (MainActivity.kt:3057-3125,
  mapTouchToVideoCoords); that mapping depends on the device's view layout, so the expected point for a tap at the
  view's centre is only RECORDED (aim / off), not judged.
- the Windows tab: listWindowsButton must be visible and enabled (else FAIL, no tap); recorded on the 3 line
  (windowsTab shown=<bounds> enabled=1). <n>_targets_ui.txt keeps the real screen.
Gates, OFF, job, slot, adb: unchanged. No device run.

oa_pick_test.py 19/19: controls 3 and 4 PASS; NEGATIVE 4 none, uponly, outside, pretap (a down/up logged before the tap
-- checked present -- and nothing after), moveonly, downonly, moved (up at another position); the 3 negatives as
before. Regressions: oa_pmclear_test 12/12, oa_adb_redact_test 7/7, oa_orchestration_test 22/22.
